# Generated DoubleDeal-CBC-HMAC Lean

**Do not edit these files by hand.** They are produced from
[`primitives/aead/doubledeal-cbc-hmac/doubledeal_cbc_hmac.sudo`](../../../../primitives/aead/doubledeal-cbc-hmac/doubledeal_cbc_hmac.sudo)
by `proofs/emit_lean.sh`, with MegaDreifach imported via
`-I primitives/hash/megadreifach`.

This directory is a standalone Lake package (its own `lakefile.lean`).
There is no algebraic proof package next door. `lake-manifest.json` is
committed so `lean-action` can `lake build`; do not gitignore it.

This is not Link 2, not emitter soundness, and not an AEAD security
theorem.

See [`proofs/ANTI_DRIFT.md`](../../../ANTI_DRIFT.md).
